title: Seaside Vacation Rental with Tower Views & Porches Sleeps 8
meta_description: 3BR Seaside vacation rental for 8 with a private tower, observation decks, outdoor living spaces, and walkable beach access.
description_expanded: A Colorful Coastal Retreat in the Heart of SeasideRelax and unwind at Admiral Boom’s, a vibrant and spacious beach home ideally located in the heart of Seaside, Florida. This charming coastal vacation rental comfortably sleeps up to eight guests and welcomes you with a whimsical red, white, blue, and yellow exterior, framed by lush landscaping and tucked behind a picturesque gate. A full-length front porch sets the tone for laid-back coastal living, featuring a lighted outdoor dining area, a cozy bench swing, and an additional Adirondack seating area on the side deck—perfect for soaking in the Seaside breeze after a day at the beach.Bright, Airy Living Spaces with Classic Beach House CharmStep inside to a light-filled interior designed for comfort and connection. The front living room offers ample seating with a large sofa, two club chairs, a card table, and a flat-screen TV—ideal for family movie nights or quiet evenings in. The well-equipped kitchen provides plenty of storage and cookware for preparing meals at home, while the adjacent dining area seats four, complemented by a charming breakfast nook for two.Tucked away at the rear of the first floor, the main-level bedroom features a king bed, built-in reading nook, abundant natural light, and a small closet. This bedroom has convenient access to a shared full bathroom with a single vanity and a sleek glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Upstairs Bedrooms, Porches & Flexible Sleeping SpacesUpstairs, guests will find two additional bedrooms, a bonus bunk nook, and two open-air porches that expand the home’s relaxed coastal living. The primary king suite offers its own sitting area with a sofa, reading lights, and a mounted flat-screen TV. Step out onto the private porch with a bench swing overlooking peaceful Forest Street—an ideal spot for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The en-suite bathroom includes a single vanity and a glass walk-in shower.Down the hall, a cheerful twin-over-twin bunk nook—separated by a pocket door—provides a cozy space for younger guests. Nearby, the third bedroom features a queen bed and opens onto a private balcony with a hammock for laid-back lounging. These two spaces share a Jack-and-Jill bathroom with a single vanity, walk-in shower, and generous storage.Private Tower Views & Outdoor ExtrasAt the top of the home, a private enclosed tower serves as a peaceful retreat, complete with two observation decks offering breathtaking views of Seaside. Whether you’re enjoying sunrise coffee or winding down with a nightcap at the outdoor bar seating, this elevated perch delivers unforgettable moments above the treetops.Additional conveniences include a laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer, an enclosed outdoor shower for rinsing off after beach days, and a grill for casual outdoor meals.A True Seaside ClassicJust a short stroll from Seaside’s sugar-white sands and turquoise Gulf waters, Admiral Boom’s is a timeless Seaside vacation rental that blends character, comfort, and an unbeatable location. Perfect for families or groups seeking space, charm, and walkability, this beloved beach home is ready to host your next unforgettable Seaside, Florida getaway.Need More Room?This property also features a separate back house on the premises, available to rent through our company. For additional space or traveling with a larger group, consider reserving both homes together - Poppin's Place.FEATURESPrivate Seaside residential beach access at West Ruskin, the largest private residential beach along Scenic Highway 30AApprox. 5-minute walk / 528 yards to beach accessFull-size washer and dryerOutdoor grill for casual coastal cookingOutdoor shower, perfect after beach daysThis home streams live TV through YouTube TV, so you can catch local channels, sports, and favorite shows right from the smart TVsPrivate tower with two observation decks offering elevated views of SeasidePeacock Alley linens throughout the home, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and towelsAccess to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityTwo parking passes included; golf carts are considered vehicles—golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited; special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets permitted
